query.description: what to look for, in plain words (several labels: one per line)

instances.description: {box, mask}. box = [x0,y0,x1,y1] in pixels; mask = path to binary PNG at the image size

tool.name: segment_object
tool.description: Find objects in an image and get a binary mask for each one, to select or isolate them.
tool.returns: Returns instances: a list of {box, mask}, empty if nothing was found. box = [x0,y0,x1,y1] in pixels; mask = path to a binary PNG at the image size. Also model and seconds.
